list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). PSN count targets are from PSNProfiles. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
onlineNote: The official list has no online trophy: every trophy is earned in single-player. The Online filter therefore shows an empty state on purpose.

stages.blurb: Play the opening mission and finish Chapter 1. Two story trophies, both unmissable.
stages.title: Opening: Gone Fishing and Chapter 1

stages.blurb: Play the story through to its end. Four chapter and finale trophies, all unmissable.
stages.title: Main story: Chapters 2 to 4 and the finale

stages.blurb: The six named story missions, in story order. Each pops when its mission ends.
stages.title: Story missions

stages.blurb: Five strangers' final missions, plus 8 full stranger strands. Start these as soon as strangers appear on the map.
stages.title: Strangers across Leonida

stages.blurb: The game's side pastimes: ranges, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, stunts and challenges. Sample them early, grind them late.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.blurb: Partner jobs and heat: wanted levels, shop and vault robberies, armored trucks, gang operations and Combat Focus.
stages.title: Crime with your partner

stages.blurb: Cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, the whole map, garages, laundering and shopping. Best done while travelling between story beats.
stages.title: Collecting, exploring and spending

stages.blurb: The slow counters and the odd one-off moments, then 100% completion — and the platinum pops.
stages.title: The long road to the platinum

trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion, which PSN tracks as a 0 to 100 counter. In past GTA games 100% means all story missions, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and side tasks; the exact checklist for GTA VI is not public yet, so treat this as the final cleanup trophy and work from the in-game stats page once it is known — to be confirmed. It is a gold trophy and usually the last one players earn before the platinum.
